chapters.title: Exam blueprint
chapters.overview: Permissions, sandboxes, channels, events, actions, data sources, APIs.

chapters.title: AJO and RTCDP foundations
chapters.overview: Adobe Journey Optimizer is built on Adobe Experience Platform. Platform provides the data foundation; AJO uses that foundation to orchestrate experiences and deliver messages.

chapters.title: 1. Administration and configuration 20%
chapters.overview: Access is managed through users, roles, permissions, and product-level access. A role groups permissions; users receive access through role assignment. Apply least privilege: grant only the capabilities needed for the task.
topics: 1.4 Events, custom actions, custom data sources

chapters.title: 2. Journey orchestration 22%
chapters.overview: Coordinate channels around customer state and preferences, not by blindly sending the same message everywhere. Example: on cart abandonment, wait, check for purchase, send email if consented and reachable, wait and re-check conversion, then consider push only if eligible. If no channel is eligible, exit or follow an approved non-marketing path.

chapters.title: 3. Offer decisioning 16%
chapters.overview: Eligibility answers can this offer be shown? Ranking answers which eligible offer should be selected? An offer with the highest priority but a failed eligibility rule must not win. Ranking is not a substitute for compliance or eligibility.
topics: 3.5 Offer Hub / Decisions Hub vs Edge Decisioning API

chapters.title: 4. Content authoring 22%
chapters.overview: Content authoring includes channel-specific configuration, rendering, personalization, fallback behavior, compliance, link validation, and test-profile verification—not just copywriting.
topics: 4.5 Preview, proof, validation, approval, publish, pause

chapters.title: 5. Data modeling 18%
chapters.overview: XDM schemas define structure and meaning. A schema combines a class and field groups, with custom fields where appropriate. Schemas create consistent data structures across source systems and Platform services.

chapters.title: Advanced troubleshooting
chapters.overview: Expert questions often give a symptom and ask for the best diagnostic sequence. Find where the flow breaks, inspect evidence at that layer, and change one thing at a time.
